(2) V1 SDK task signature is `(input, context)`; `_make_handler` handler takes one `payload` arg and indexes `payload["input"]["manifest"]` — EmptyModel default input validator breaks this on first live dispatch. (3) hatchet-lite official compose gRPC port is 7077, not the hardcoded 7070 in cli.py/_real_client(). (4) The UNCOMMITTED validation.yml working-tree diff IS the gate weakening (UMD_VALIDATE_LIVE_WORKER opt-in default off, db-api-only); committed HEAD a6b1a62 was fail-closed full-stack — the weakening has never run in CI. (5) debugger report exists untracked on disk (186 lines) — T1's missing-artifact note is stale. (6) python-multipart pin, ffmpeg absence, PGDG client-17, ghcr sub-path images all verified correct. Verdicts: A/B/C SURVIVE-WITH-CONDITIONS, D DEAD standalone (topology skew + lite gRPC port divergence).

title: T2 critique: SDK verification + A1-A4 failure-mode analysis (live Hatchet blocker)
body: Verified against raw GitHub py/1.38.1: Task.call/aio_call = fn(workflow_input, ctx) two-arg (task.py); EmptyModel frozen extra=allow, not subscriptable (types.py); TWorkflowInput bound includes dict[str,Any]; durable_task exists w/ sync-deprecation warning (task.py __init__), to_proto emits is_durable + slot_requests {"durable":1}; mock_run/_create_mock_context drops raw dicts to {} (only dataclass/BaseModel serialized); Worker.register_workflow->put_workflow, sys.exit(1) on failure (worker.py); Workflow.id -> client.workflows.list(workflow_name=exact name) w/ client-side == filter (workflow.py) — A3's workflow_name="umd-" filter semantics UNVERIFIED and likely exact-match (HIGH risk for A3); scheduler lists tenants per schedulerPartitionId (engine tenant.go) confirming AT-17 partition mechanism; PyPI 1.38.1 + server v0.105.2 released 2026-08-25. Key findings: (1) A1 fallback chain `durable_task or task or workflow` silently violates AT-18 if durable_task missing — must hard-fail instead; (2) ready line printed BEFORE worker.start() and put_workflow can sys.exit(1) AFTER it — exact-count fix closes local fabrication but engine assertions remain the only proof (C6 still honest as candidate); (3) A3 cannot prove callback or is_durable via workflows.list — declaration-visible only; (4) A4 aio_mock_run EXISTS (Ideator PROVISIONAL upgraded to VERIFIED); engine durable path churny at v0.105.2 (#4702/#4768/#4758 landed in this release) — A4 expands repair blast radius. Verdicts: A1 SURVIVES-WITH-CONDITIONS, A2 SURVIVES-WITH-CONDITIONS (primary), A3 SURVIVES-WITH-CONDITIONS as test-only addition, A4 SURVIVES-WITH-CONDITIONS as deliberate forward-compat only. No L1-L21 at hard risk if A1 fallback corrected + mypy PROVISIONAL resolves.
